name: warehouse-system
description: Full core Warehouse Management System - NestJS API + React admin UI

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:sqlite: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:sqlite" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
